newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-N.Z lags the dollar pack.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-N.Z lags the dollar pack.

text.p: Long-dated Australian bonds continued to advance their recent rally, buoyed by a positive U.S. Treasury market, causing spreads to tighten once again.

Meanwhile, the New Zealand market remained under severe pressure from an ailing N.Z. dollar, and was once again was trying to compensate to bring the market in line with the RBNZ's desired monetray conditions.
However, global debt markets will be eagerly awaiting the outcome of the July U.S. non-fram payrolls report later on Friday for the early direction next week.
